campaign.title: Bombieri--Iwaniec double-large-sieve and two-spacing source map

resource_policy.literature_policy: Audit the official Li--Yang arXiv:2308.14859v2 TeX source literally, including the definition of S, both conditions on F, corrected Case-A sign, q/N/R/Q/K/L/eta hypotheses, the symbolic first-spacing norm, the second-spacing variables, and the final S/H target. Reuse the accepted Round-95 repair only within its certified scope. No theorem-name or global Li--Yang conclusion substitutes for a map to the project scalar.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact Li--Yang/Bombieri--Iwaniec standard sum, double-large-sieve inequality, and first/second-spacing machinery be mapped without changing coefficient ownership or absolute-value placement to the literal Round-131 top-shell determinant correlation and produce a complete fixed-block exponent below 27/48; if not, what is the first exact source or normal-form mismatch?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Estimate the literal fixed-centre scalar O_(i,D)^+(c)=sum_(r=(a,b))^lit A_i(r) sum_(r'=(a',b'))^lit B_i(r,r') e(ca/(kappa_i b)-ca'/(kappa_i b')), with n=ab'-a'b>0, the taper 1-Wn/(kappa_i bb'), kappa_1=1 and kappa_2=4, and every primitive lift, threshold, Stieltjes/Mobius profile, quarter or chi_4 carrier, reciprocal alias, taper, star, cell, sign, and owner retained. The candidate single-wave phase map is h=a, m=b, H_LY=L, M_LY=D, T_LY=c/kappa_i, F(z)=1/z; this map must be checked rather than assumed to extend to the joint correlation.
quantities: project scales W=Y^(7/16), D=Y^(1/2), L=Y^(1/6), c asymp Y, |a| and |a'| asymp L, b and b' asymp D
0<n=ab'-a'b lesssim kappa_i bb'/W, fixed-outer bounded determinant-lift multiplicity, complete capacity Y^(35/48+epsilon)
ideal one-term-per-ray persistence threshold Y^(27/48+epsilon), determinant target Y^(24/48+epsilon)
candidate Li--Yang parameters H_LY=Y^(1/6), M_LY=Y^(1/2), T_LY=Y, so H_LY/M_LY=T_LY^(-1/3)
source derivative approximants a_BI/r_BI and project primitive rays (a,b) are different variable roles until an exact bijection is proved

completion_criteria: Produce an exact primary-source card for Li--Yang arXiv:2308.14859v2 Section 4: the sum S, BV weights, both conditions on F, corrected Case (A), Case (B), q and N hypotheses, the R/Q/K/L/eta definitions, the double-large-sieve bound, both spacing problems, and the final S/H target. Preserve the Round-95 warnings on the printed general ranges.

Verify or refute the candidate single-wave phase map h=a, m=b, H_LY=L, M_LY=D, T_LY=c/kappa_i, F(z)=1/z, including signs, dyadic boxes, F derivative conditions, BV weights, endpoints, and the exact source parameter powers.

Derive a literal map from the joint determinant correlation to one source S, a controlled superposition of source S sums, or the underlying double-large-sieve form. Price every decomposition and do not separate the pair coefficient for free.

Distinguish the project primitive ray (a,b) from the source Dirichlet derivative approximant a_BI/r_BI. Map or refute all four first/second-spacing coordinates, modular inverses, coprimality, short intervals, major/minor arcs, and real-centre conditions.
Compute the actual coefficient/projective/BV norms after physical Stieltjes/Mobius reassembly and preserve thresholds, stars, tapers, aliases, cells, signs, and owners.
Translate any legal S/H or double-large-sieve estimate back to a complete Y exponent and price broad, narrow, major, minor, boundary, threshold, and owner strata against 35/48, 27/48, and 24/48.
Close under exactly one label: applicable_positive_margin, exact_missing_hypothesis, or source_level_no_go.
Make no global exponent, M9-M1, M9-M2, endpoint, bridge, M9, or quarter promotion.

tasks.target: Audit the official Li--Yang arXiv:2308.14859v2 source at the exact Bombieri--Iwaniec interface. required_output: A seven-section primary-source report with official arXiv citations and exact local source lines or equation labels.
A theorem and variable-role card that distinguishes source summation variables from derivative approximants and spacing variables.
An explicit list of conclusions not contained in the source.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Starting from the literal Round-131 scalar and accepted Round-132 chart, verify the exact single-wave Li--Yang phase map and then derive or refute a complete owner-preserving map of the joint determinant correlation to Li--Yang S or the underlying double-large-sieve/two-spacing normal form. Compute every source parameter, spacing coordinate, coefficient norm, owner cost, and resulting Y exponent.
required_output: An exact project-to-source variable, phase, coefficient, spacing, and exponent table.
A legal applicable stratum with complete margin, one exact missing hypothesis, or a source-level no-go.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Using only the supplied corrected source statement and literal scalar packet, independently determine the weakest legal consequence of the Li--Yang/Bombieri--Iwaniec machinery for the fixed-centre joint determinant correlation. Test variable roles, separability, both spacing problems, aligned rulings, and capacity, and name the first invalid inference if no strict cross-ray power follows.
excluded_context: all Round-95 through Round-133 nonblind artifacts
required_output: The weakest theorem-level implication or a counter-implication with the first invalid inference named exactly.
At least one coefficient/role control and one spacing/capacity control with explicit powers.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

review_seams.requirement: The official v2 source definition of S, both F conditions, corrected ranges, BI parameter definitions, both spacing problems, and S/H target are recorded literally.
Project rays, source h/m summation variables, derivative approximants, short-interval labels, and first/second-spacing variables are never conflated.
The joint physical coefficient is mapped with an explicit BV/projective cost and every threshold, modulus, star, taper, alias, sign, and owner retained.
All first- and second-spacing coordinates, modular inverses, coprimality, major/minor arcs, and real-centre hypotheses receive a literal project counterpart or an exact mismatch.
A theorem for one separably weighted S, an averaged spacing norm, or a positive large-sieve energy is not substituted for the prescribed-centre signed joint scalar.
Every decomposition and uncovered stratum is priced against 35/48, the strict 27/48 persistence threshold, and the 24/48 determinant target.
